rationale: C15 is a highly plausible drafting template. Both letters propose creating an additional Assistant Secretary in a Cabinet department, justify the position by pointing to expanding departmental responsibilities requiring high-level attention, transmit the necessary bill, and enclose a letter from the relevant Secretary explaining the proposal. This is substantially more concrete and distinctive than the generic bill-transmittal similarities found in C06 and C22.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I am transmitting herewith a bill to provide for an Assistant Secretary of Labor in the Department of Labor.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: I, therefore, recommend that there he established in the Department a position of Assistant Secretary of Health, Education, and Welfare... Transmitted herewith is a draft of a bill which would carry out this purpose.
shared_material.explanation: Both transmit legislation establishing an Assistant Secretary position in a named department.

shared_material.child_excerpt: This bill will better enable the Department of Labor to meet its increasing responsibilities in connection with the growing role of women in the work force of the Nation.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The vast increase in the international responsibilities of the Secretary of Health, Education, and Welfare in recent years has made this a major activity of that Department. It is important and requires continuing attention at a high level.
shared_material.explanation: The later letter adapts the same rationale: growing departmental responsibilities create a need for an additional senior official.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I am enclosing, also, a letter from the Secretary of Labor describing the need for the bill.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: Enclosed is a letter from the Secretary of Health, Education, and Welfare describing the proposal in more detail.
shared_material.explanation: The letters conclude with closely parallel references to an enclosed departmental Secretary's explanation.
